text: ohep; Turk.: Innohep; UK: Innohep; USA: Innohep. Tioclomarol (rINN) LM-550; Tioclomarolum. 3-[5-Chloro-α-(4-chloro-β-hydroxy- phenethyl)-2-thenyl]-4-hydroxycoumarin. Тиокломарол C22H16Cl2O4S = 447.3. CAS — 22619-35-8. ATC — B01AA11. ATC Vet — QB01AA11. Profile Tioclomarol is an oral coumarin anticoagulant with actions sim- ilar to those of warfarin (p.1425) that has been used in the man- agement of thromboembolic disorders. Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) Fr.: Apegmone†. Тирилазада Мезилат C38H52N6O2,CH4O3S,xH2O = 721.0 (anhydrous). CAS — 110101-66-1 (tirilazad); 111793-42-1 (tirilazad mesilate); 149042-61-5 (tirilazad mesilate). ATC — N07XX01. ATC Vet — QN07XX01. (tirilazad) Profile Tirilazad, a lazaroid, is an inhibitor of lipid peroxidation thought to have a cytoprotective effect against radicals produced in re- sponse to tissue trauma. It has been used in the prevention of sec- ondary tissue damage in subarachnoid haemorrhage. It has also been investigated in spinal cord injuries, head injuries, and ischaemic stroke. ◊ References. 1. Fleishaker JC, et al.
